key_facts: Symptoms have been present for more than 10 years
Lesions are localized to the left shin
Milia are present in the superficial dermis
Erosions with partially detached epidermis are present
No abnormalities of the mucous membranes, nails, hair, or teeth
Genetic testing identified a novel heterozygous missense variant in COL7A1

raw.rationale: The presence of itchy erythematous to violaceous papules and plaques, milia, and erosions with partially detached epidermis, along with the localization to the left shin and the genetic variant in COL7A1, are consistent with Epidermolysis Bullosa Pruriginosa.

rejected.label: Dominant Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa
rejected.why: While the genetic variant in COL7A1 is consistent with this diagnosis, the clinical presentation and localization are more typical of Epidermolysis Bullosa Pruriginosa.

rejected.label: Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa
rejected.why: This diagnosis is too broad and does not account for the specific clinical features and localization of the lesions.

rejected.label: Bullous Pemphigoid
rejected.why: The absence of mucous membrane involvement and the presence of a genetic variant in COL7A1 make this diagnosis less likely.
